##Analysis

###Distribution

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(df_counts, aes(x=expression)) + # df_counts: raw counts matrix, expression: expression values
      geom_histogram(
      bins = 50,
      fill = "skyblue",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3) +
      labs(
      title = "Raw counts",
      subtitle = sample_id,
      x = "Raw count",
      y = "Number of genes"
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p1
```
